title: Use pathlib instead of os.path
rationale: pathlib provides a clean object-oriented interface and resolves Windows slash quirks automatically.

alternatives.text: Keep os.path with custom normalize function
alternatives.reason: Too error-prone across different Windows drives and UNC paths.

evidence.quote: Custom normalize wrapper broke on UNC paths
We decided to adopt pathlib because it makes cross-platform path handling much cleaner.

title: Drop Python 2 runtime support
rationale: Python 2 is end of life and maintaining dual syntax grammars creates unsustainable complexity.

evidence.quote: We decided against supporting Python 2.7 in Black formatting.

title: PEP 622 Structural Pattern Matching Syntax
rationale: Dedicated match/case statements provide explicit destructuring without grammar ambiguities.

alternatives.reason: C-style switch has completely different fall-through semantics and creates user confusion.

evidence.quote: We rejected using switch keyword because of ambiguity with C-style semantics.
A dedicated match block works much better than overloading existing constructs.

title: Default line length 88 characters
rationale: 88 characters represents a pragmatic compromise between 79 chars PEP 8 and wider 100+ character screens.

alternatives.reason: Causes excessive vertical splitting for modern descriptive identifier names.

evidence.quote: 79 chars causes too many awkward multi-line splits
88 characters is about 10% more than 79 and fits well on side-by-side editor splits.

title: Revert custom regex path normalization
rationale: Reverted the regex path approach because it broke Windows UNC root path detection.

evidence.quote: Reverting this approach: reason: it broke Windows path handling.
